hints: Look at the two most important regions in IR, the broad area around 2500 to 3500 cm-1 and the sharp strong dip around 1700 cm-1.
Notice there is a very broad absorption from about 2500 to 3500 cm-1 plus a very strong sharp absorption at about 1710 cm-1 for C=O.
Think which functional group needs both a C=O and a very broad O-H together, and match that to the four propan- compounds.
walkthrough:
**Spot the carbonyl peak**

Look for a strong, sharp dip with low transmittance. Here there is a very strong peak at about 1710 cm-1.

$$\text{absorption at } \approx 1700 \text{ cm}^{-1} \text{ = C=O stretch}$$

**Check the O-H region**

Now look at 2500 to 3500 cm-1. There is a very broad, deep trough centred near 3000 cm-1, with small spikes on top from C-H.

$$\text{broad absorption } 2500-3300 \text{ cm}^{-1} \text{ = O-H in carboxylic acid}$$

**Combine the two clues**

A C=O plus a very broad O-H is the classic fingerprint of a carboxylic acid. An alcohol O-H is broad but higher and narrower, around 3200 to 3600 cm-1, and has no C=O.

$$\text{C=O + broad O-H = } \text{RCOOH}$$

**Match to the options**

All four options have three carbons. Only propanoic acid, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$, contains both a C=O and an acidic O-H, so it fits the spectrum perfectly.

options.A: Propan-1-ol, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$, has an O-H but no C=O. It would show a broad O-H around 3200 to 3600 cm-1 but no strong peak at 1710 cm-1, so it cannot explain the strong carbonyl dip.
options.B: Propanal, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO}$, has a C=O around 1720 to 1740 cm-1 but no O-H. It would not show the very broad absorption from 2500 to 3500 cm-1 seen here.
options.C: Propanoic acid, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$, has both groups. The strong sharp peak at about 1710 cm-1 is the C=O stretch, and the very broad trough from 2500 to 3500 cm-1 is the hydrogen-bonded O-H of the acid. This combination matches exactly.
options.D: Propanone, $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3$, is a ketone with a C=O around 1715 cm-1 but no O-H. Like propanal, it cannot explain the broad O-H absorption.
